QuestInfo.name: Bearded Ambition
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2020000##k has some unusual facial hair. You can find them in #b#m211000000##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2020000# says he grew his rockin' beard with the strength of his Ambition. He learned Ambition back when he was a well-known hunter in #m211000000#... Try hunting  #r#o6130103##k and #r#o6230200##k as #p2020000# once did.

#o6130103##r #a295141##k
#o6230200##r #a295142##k

0.0: Here to ask about my beard, are you? Haha, I get that all the time. So, let me tell you what I tell the rest: my beard is a mark of my Ambition.
0.1: Don't believe me? It's true. This beard is testimony to my history and my experience. Without the kind of Ambition that carried me through harder times, I'd never have the strength of character to grow such a full and manly beard.
0.2: When I was younger, I was well known throughout #m211000000# for my strength. Not even Scadur could match me as a hunter. It's through the hunt that I learned the true meaning of Ambition. Why don't you try a little hunting yourself?

yes.0: Back in the day, I always used to hunt #r#o6130103#s#k and #r#o6230200#s#k. Why don't you try hunting 300 of each?

no.0: How can you say no to this beard?

1.0: Hm, not too bad. You look a little more grown up than before. Of course, you haven't sprouted a magnificent beard like mine, but you can't have it all. Hahaha!
1.1: The beard is symbolic, of course. You understand, right? If you do, then you already know true Ambition.

mob.0: Still tracking the #r#o6130103#s#k and #r#o6230200#s#k, eh? Hmm... It's really not that hard of a task.
